title: M/s Tayal Steels (Pvt.) Ltd. v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Sudhir Agarwal, J.; Om Prakash-VII, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed following Dev Prayag Paper Mill.
headnote: Challenge to a demand of additional security for electricity supply, and to clause 4.20(1) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 as ultra vires section 47(5) of the Electricity Act, 2003, dismissed in terms of Dev Prayag Paper Mill.
facts: M/s Tayal Steels challenged a 22 May 2009 demand for additional security for electricity supply. On 29 October 2009 the Court connected the writ with a similar petition and stayed deposit of that security till the next listing; the stay continued on 9 February 2010 after no counter-affidavit was filed. At disposal, counsel accepted that identical challenges to additional security and to clause 4.20(1) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 as ultra vires section 47(5) of the Electricity Act, 2003 had been dismissed in Dev Prayag Paper Mill.

holding_units.holding: A writ challenging a demand of additional security for supply of electricity, and clause 4.20(1) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 (insofar as it conditions the consumer's option on the licensee's choice) as ultra vires section 47(5) of the Electricity Act, 2003, is dismissed in terms of M/s Dev Prayag Paper Mill (Pvt.) v. State of U.P. (Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016, 21.03.2017).
